IS_TEST().notice: Marker used by Forge to identify test contracts.

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

invariant_credited_leq_routed().notice: The recycle pairing never credits more than was routed in.

invariant_fd_bookkeeping().notice: Fee accounting: FD balance equals what harvests actually sent minus what was routed out (recycle to vault counts as routed out too).

invariant_no_zero_valued_depositor().notice: No depositor is ever left with a zero-valued position while holding shares.

invariant_price_never_below_one().notice: §3.2 — the share-price floor: totalAssets >= totalShares at all times (price never below 1; donation/harvest/withdraw flooring cannot break it).

invariant_solvency().notice: §3.6 — vault withdrawals are honored by real assets: the sum of all real USDC held by the vault + its strategies never falls below the accounted totalAssets.

invariant_user_shares_sum_to_total().notice: §3.3 — liabilities stay in sync: user shares sum exactly to totalShares.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).

test_broken_strategy_does_not_brick_harv.notice: One broken strategy must never brick the whole vault's harvest.

test_credit_yield_requires_backing().notice: creditYield cannot credit more than actually sits in the vault.

test_donation_attack_neutralized().notice: Classic donation/first-depositor inflation attack — neutralized by the SHARE_OFFSET: the attacker recovers only ~1/(offset) of the donation, the victim's loss is bounded by one share's mint-flooring (<0.1% here).

test_dust_deposit_reverts_below_price().notice: Dust guard: once the price exceeds 1, sub-share deposits revert.

test_emergency_withdraw_dilutes_share_pr.notice: emergencyWithdraw is a crisis lever: it drains backing while shares keep their claims (price < 1 afterwards) — documented dilution semantics.

test_first_depositor_one_to_one_then_pri.notice: First depositor gets 1:1; a later depositor into an appreciated vault gets fewer shares (earnings claims hold).

test_harvest_fee_split().notice: Harvest fee split: 10% of profit to the FeeDistributor, 90% credited to depositors via the share price.

test_paused_strategy_locks_its_funds_for.notice: Paused strategy: allocate skips it, direct harvest reverts for it, and its funds are NOT recallable while paused (containment trade-off: a withdrawal larger than idle + active-strategy funds reverts until the strategy is unpaused).

test_withdraw_recalls_from_strategies().notice: Withdrawals beyond idle recall from strategies (RESERVE_BPS kept liquid).
